annotation.bound_parties_text: The vehicle manufacturer (or its accredited representative) must apply for approval and operate a Software Update Management System, while Approval Authorities and Contracting Parties must grant, verify and notify approvals.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to software update processes shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by their duly accredited representative.
annotation.dates_quote: Date of entry into force: 22 January 2021
